name: AMS
recent: AMS Advanced Material 近期以 RM550,000 收购子公司 AMS Aluprecision 剩余 10% 股权，使其成为全资子公司。董事总经理 Keh Teng Yang 在 9 月至 11 月间多次在公开市场增持股份，包括闭市期内的交易。公司截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度录得净利 274 万令吉，并持续扩大铝加工产能与半导体相关业务。
notable: 以 RM550,000 收购子公司 AMS Aluprecision 剩余 10% 股权，交易完成后持股 100%。
截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度录得净利 274 万令吉。
董事总经理 Keh Teng Yang 在 9 月至 11 月间多次增持公司股份。
risks: 董事总经理 Keh Teng Yang 在闭市期内进行股份交易。
公司于 2026 年 9 月 23 日公告关联方交易（收购 AMS Aluprecision 剩余股权）。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，公司营收为 3890 万令吉，净利为 11.8 万令吉，净利率 0.3%。

recent_en: AMS Advanced Material recently acquired the remaining 10% stake in subsidiary AMS Aluprecision for RM550,000, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary. Managing Director Keh Teng Yang increased his shareholding multiple times in the open market between September and November, including trades during the closed period. The company reported a net profit of RM2.74 million for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 and continues to expand aluminium processing capacity and semiconductor-related business.
notable_en: Acquired the remaining 10% stake in subsidiary AMS Aluprecision for RM550,000, raising its shareholding to 100%.
Reported a net profit of RM2.74 million for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.
Managing Director Keh Teng Yang increased his shareholding in the company multiple times between September and November.
risks_en: Managing Director Keh Teng Yang traded shares during the closed period.
The company announced a related party transaction on 23 September 2026 (acquisition of remaining stake in AMS Aluprecision).
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM38.9 million, net profit was RM118,000, and net margin was 0.3%.
